prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Miami for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objective “best” dentist for implants — the right provider depends on the complexity of your case and what matters to you (experience, specialty training, price, location, language, insurance, technology). I can help you find a top option in Miami, but first here are practical things to look for and questions to ask so you get the best outcome.

Who to consider
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons (OMS) or periodontists — typically place implants and handle bone grafts/surgery.
- Prosthodontists or implant-trained restorative dentists — design and place the final crown/bridge/overdenture and manage the prosthetic phase.
- Some multi‑disciplinary practices coordinate placement + restoration in-house (best for smoother outcomes).

Key credentials and indicators of quality
- Specialty training (periodontics, prosthodontics, OMFS) or advanced implant fellowships.
- Diplomate status with relevant boards (e.g., ABOI/ID), membership in AAOMS, AAID, or ITI.
- Regularly performs implants (high volume correlates with better outcomes).
- Uses CBCT (3D imaging) and digital planning/guide systems.
- Good before/after photos and patient reviews.
- Clear fees, financing options, and implant brands used.
- Willingness to show cases similar to yours and discuss complications/success rates.

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implants do you place per year? Success rate?
- Who will do the surgical placement and who will restore the implant?
- Do you use CBCT and guided surgery?
- What implant system/brand do you use?
- Do I need bone grafting/sinus lift? What are my alternatives?
- Timeline from placement to final restoration?
- Sedation/anesthesia options and related costs?
- Do you offer a warranty/maintenance plan for implant restorations?
- Can I see before/after photos or speak with past patients?

Where to look for Miami providers
- Google / Yelp / Healthgrades / RealSelf for reviews and photos.
- AAOMS and ADA find-a-dentist tools.
- University of Miami School of Dentistry (faculty clinics often handle complex cases at reasonable cost).

If you want, I can:
- Search and give a short list of highly rated implant specialists in Miami (with addresses, phone numbers, credentials and a quick note on expertise). If so, tell me your Miami ZIP or neighborhood and any preferences (budget, English/Spanish language, want sedation, etc.).
